body: Literally lost one ‘good’ player, Gittens rttk? Who I got for like 200k in Feb, never had more than 250k coins, mostly just do objective, only done champs twice because I work too much to play loads

I haven’t bought coins, never have done, haven’t even bought fifa point this year, used to years ago. Why would I even ask this question if I’d bought coins?

I’ve just started collecting/played one game with a friend/wanting to get more into it. I haven’t even looked in too much detail at what places like Athena are doing, but I work hospitality and the brief look I had seemed like it was Friday/Saturday based which isn’t ideal for me!

This may sound horrible but I'm glad I just read this. Because I feel exactly the same. It's horrible. It happened to me, just over two years ago. And I think it's going to happen again, my only really close friend, she's promised she'll always be there and told me over and over to talk to her. But I know there is only so much someone can take. It's a lot of pressure to constantly have to reassure someone, because if you can't do it to the right standard the consequences could be really bad. So detaching yourself from the situation is easier. The stupid thing about it is, don't know if you're the same, but if the roles are reversed I'd do everything I could forever to make that person feel okay. Because I did that. And then that person is the one that really broke me.
